hero.subtitle1: Dragolink natively integrates with your favorite marketing, sales, and analytics platforms.
hero.subtitle2: Automate link creation, sync click data in real-time, and trigger workflows across 5,000+ apps without writing a single line of code.

integrations.name: Slack
integrations.description: Instantly generate short links directly from Slack channels using slash commands, and receive real-time notifications for malicious link detections.

integrations.name: Salesforce
integrations.description: Automatically append UTM parameters and shorten links for SMS campaigns, while syncing click engagement data directly to Lead and Contact records.

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.description: Trigger Dragolink link creation within HubSpot workflows. Use click events as enrollment triggers for advanced email nurturing sequences.

integrations.name: Zapier
integrations.description: Connect Dragolink to 5,000+ apps. Create "Zaps" to automatically shorten links when new content is published on WordPress, Medium, or Webflow.

integrations.name: Webhooks
integrations.description: Push real-time click and scan data to your internal servers. Build custom dashboards and trigger programmatic actions the moment a link is accessed.

integrations.name: Google Analytics 4
integrations.description: Automatically map Dragolink campaign parameters to GA4 properties. Ensure perfectly unified attribution across all your paid and organic channels.

cta.title: Need a custom integration?
cta.description: Our enterprise solutions engineering team can help you build custom connectors for your proprietary internal systems.
